title: Formal bi-entire weighted-coefficient completion and radius-loss derivative bridge
question: Does the formal bi-entire coefficient topology admit a representation-independent weighted-l1 completion with dense finite polynomials, submultiplicative Cauchy product, and explicit radius-loss derivative bounds?
method: Represent the two-degree formal coefficient space as weighted l1 arrays on N^2 and use weighted convolution for multiplication.
Verify finite-support product submultiplicativity and formal field/source derivatives on a rational fixture.
Use a two-ratio geometric coefficient family to test exact weighted-norm tails and finite truncation density.
Run independent SymPy and Fraction lanes and compile Lean R224 for rational product, derivative, full-norm, and tail fixtures.
finding: At the formal coefficient level, weighted l1 arrays form a complete convolution algebra, finite-support truncations are dense, and strict radius loss gives derivative constants R/(R-R')^2 and S/(S-S')^2. The fixture has product norm 19/9 <= 34/9, derivative norms 4/3 and 11/9, constants 18 and 48, full geometric norm 7/6, and degree-three tail 1919/9261000 < 1/100. Primary passes 20/20, independent passes 20/20, integrated passes 37/37, and Lean R224 passes.
decision_reason: This removes the purely formal completion ambiguity left by EXP-001041 and provides a candidate target topology for an actual Q3 common-core map. It is deliberately not promoted to an operator completion because no representation-independent CCR domain map, energy/state bridge, or history continuity estimate has been proved.

adversarial_review.check: Weighted coefficient l1 completeness is not unbounded CCR operator closure or a physical observable algebra.
Finite-support density relies on absolute weighted summability; the geometric fixture is not the general theorem.
The derivative estimates require strict radius loss and do not close same-radius generators.
Product continuity does not establish actual Q3 Duhamel words, cancellations, or spatial first-passage decay.
R224 checks rational fixtures only; it does not formalize the full infinite weighted-l1 proof.
No KMS, OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result is claimed.

qft_interface.closed: Formal weighted coefficient completion, dense finite truncations, convolution bound, and radius-loss derivative bridge.
qft_interface.open: Physical Q3 common-core map, energy/state bridge, repeated histories, spatial first-passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS/OS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 TECT production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing formal completion checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 operator dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, common alpha, KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
next_action: Define an explicit candidate map from the actual Q3 common core into the formal weighted coefficient completion, then test whether the shifted-force/history map is continuous with volume and orientation control; record a no-go if the map cannot be made canonical.
